description: This Is the Only Earth We GetI grew up in Cleveland, Ohio, less than a mile from Lake Erie.Every summer, we’d head down to the water. Swim. Sit in the sun. Not think too much about anything beyond that moment.We didn’t worry about pollution or water quality.We just knew it was there.Clean enough. Safe enough. Ours.Now I think about that differently.Because not everyone has that experience anymore.And not everyone will.I’m running for Congress because freedom doesn’t mean much if you can’t breath
